title: Park City Old Town #209 | KEY.co
description_expanded: The home spans over two thousand three hundred square feet, featuring four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to ten guests. The living room is a cozy haven with a plush modern sectional, leather armchairs, a 50-inch TV, and a warm gas fireplace, perfect for relaxing after a day of adventure. The fully equipped gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting a stainless steel Wolf range, SubZero refrigerator, and beautiful stone countertops, with a spacious island that seats four. Adjacent to the kitchen, the posh dining room invites up to ten guests to gather in style, creating an elegant setting for memorable meals and lively conversations. Park City Old Town #209 is a modern retreat perched in the heart of Historic Old Town, offering breathtaking views of the charming town and surrounding mountains. This stylish four-level home is perfectly situated just above Main Street, where world-class dining, shopping, and vibrant nightlife are just a short walk away. With the shuttle stop only steps from the front door, guests have effortless access to Kimball Junction, Deer Valley, and the Canyons Resort, making it an ideal base for exploring all that Park City has to offer year-round.
